standing.quote: (a) A person who is injured by a violation of §5A-13-5 of this code may bring a civil action against the financial institution in his or her own name in the circuit court for the county where the alleged violation occurred.
standing.quote_through: (b) The Attorney General may file a civil action for a violation of §5A-13-5 of this code:

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: The governmental entity shall terminate any business relationship with any financial institution in a commercially reasonable manner within one year of the governmental entity’s determination that a violation of the requirements of this section have occurred.

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: If the injured person prevails on his or her claim, then the court shall award the injured person reasonable attorney fees and costs.
